name: AnyModelBot v0.1 Personal AI Bots on Any Model
description: Your own open-source AI bots with memory, background tasks and chat apps.

upstream.extras: Debian bookworm ffmpeg and python3-venv (apt, unpinned) for the Film Studio and PPT Master bots

PORT.description: Port the AnyModelBot console listens on. Railway's healthcheck and the public domain use it; keep 3600.

AMB_UI_TOKEN.description: Console access token, generated at deploy (24+ letters or digits). Every request needs it; changing it signs out all browsers.

AMB_LOGIN_URL.description: Sign-in link: open it once per browser, the token then lives in a cookie. Keep it private.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your OpenAI API key; connected to AnyModelBot at start (requests go straight to OpenAI).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your Anthropic API key; connected to AnyModelBot at start (requests go straight to Anthropic).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your Google AI Studio (Gemini) API key; connected to AnyModelBot at start.

XAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your xAI API key; connected to AnyModelBot at start.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your DeepSeek API key; connected to AnyModelBot at start.

MISTRAL_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your Mistral API key; connected to AnyModelBot at start.

AMB_LANG.description: Language of the console and of bot system messages: en, zh-CN, ja, ko or ru. Can be changed later in Settings.

TZ.description: Time zone for scheduled rules and quiet hours, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds a stopping deployment gets to close channels and the model gateway (AnyModelBot exits within 10).
